summary: Plan interrogated against the confirmed spec, all active decisions (0000-0121), and the Codex read-only seam map. The card-copy and authority semantics were human-locked in chat before planning (plain-language card, agent-proposes-human-approves, leave-broken over SQL). Shape follows the proven AUTODET-1/SCHED-4B patterns: durable unique-row dedup, CAS write with narrow allowlist, fix-and-continue reuse.
gaps: saveTool whole-row upsert is unsafe for this surface (no field allowlist/precondition) - a naive implementation could clobber executable identity
tool_catalog has no history columns; provenance and prior templates need a durable home or the amendment is unauditable
The in-memory pendingRequestOnlyCapabilityReviews set cannot make deny terminal across restarts
Widening judgment does not exist anywhere; an unsound classifier could under-warn on ability-expanding changes
Card views can be stripped by the durable-send sanitizer (bit #313 class) leaving buttonless cards
Mid-run workers hold frozen access snapshots - an amendment mid-run does not retroactively fix the current run
contradictions: 0007/0025 settings authority vs writing tool_catalog directly - reconciled: settings governs SELECTION of capabilities; tool_catalog is the definition home (established at capability creation); decision 0122 records this split explicitly so it is never re-litigated
resolutions: Dedicated amendSemanticCapabilityCommandTemplates CAS repo op with field allowlist + optimistic precondition; saveTool explicitly rejected in the plan
New durable amendment-history/proposal table (migration) carrying provenance, prior templates, and terminal-deny state; permission_audit_events linked
Durable proposal row with unique (appId, capabilityId, canonical templates, canonical argv) key replaces in-memory dedup for this flow
Classifier is a pure prefix-based function, conservative by construction (unsure = widening), table-driven tests; widening only changes card copy, never authority
Sanitizer allowlist for the new card view is a named risk with a test in the provider card suites
Frozen-snapshot behavior documented as correct: the resumed next run reloads definitions (matches AUTODET-1 fix-and-continue semantics)
open_items: Values-bearing append/update templates admit one values blob per position; multi-row appends ride one argument - documented in the capability guidance, not a blocker
Decision number 0122 subject to origin/main collision check before push
